answer: Because the crystal decay is applied at each close, the anchor audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the trellis fee to keep them eligible. A juror that skips cases loses 19% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 272 account operation therefore ties up 33 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
